info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Education Enrollments Waitlists-v2-spec
info.description: This API provides access to the list of waitlisted education enrollments, allowing users to manage and monitor student enrollment statuses. Typical consumers include educational institutions and administrators who need to oversee and adjust waitlist placements for courses. The API supports retrieving comprehensive waitlist data, ensuring that schools can make informed decisions about student enrollments. By leveraging this API, stakeholders can effectively manage course capacity and enhance the enrollment experience for prospective students.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current waitlist for enrollment applications. It provides information on applicants who are currently on the waitlist, enabling better planning and resource allocation for enrollment purposes.

requestBody.description: A request to retrieve information about enrollments on the waitlist. The client should provide the necessary parameters in the body to filter or specify the request details.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the waitlist enrollment data.
